test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct indirect narration of the given sentence.

He said to me, “My phone is switched off.”

options.text: He told me that his phone was switched off.
He told me that our phone had switch off.
He told me that his phone was switch off
He told me that my phone was switched off.

solution:
The correct answer is "**He told me that his phone was switched off."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indirect speech involves reporting what someone said without using their exact words, often changing tenses and pronouns accordingly.
 
• **"He told me" **is the appropriate reporting verb for this context.
 
• **"That" **is commonly used to introduce the reported clause in indirect speech.
 
• The switch from **"My"** to **"his" **correctly adjusts the pronoun for perspective, and **"is" **to **"was" **correctly adjusts the tense.

**Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2) incorrectly uses "our" instead of "his", distorting the meaning.
 
• Option 3) provides an incorrect verb form "was switch off".
 
• Option 4) incorrectly changes "my" to "my", which misrepresents whose phone was switched off.
